photography-preview.notes: Aggressive keying - ghostly/sketchy look. Camera body partially keyed which looks cool.
photography-preview.note_alpha: Use ffmpeg 7.0.2 static build at /tmp/ffmpeg-7.0.2-amd64-static/ffmpeg for VP9 alpha. System ffmpeg 6.1.1 drops alpha. Two-step: extract RGBA PNGs with system ffmpeg, encode to VP9 with static ffmpeg 7.

music-preview.notes: Bright green screen waveform visualization. Clean key.
music-preview.ffmpeg_command: ffmpeg -y -i INPUT -vf 'format=rgba,colorkey=0x01AE07:0.38:0.12,crop=1080:1080:420:0' then encode PNGs with ffmpeg7
